description: Adelaide gateway traffic data is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Jon Kellett. The table shows inbound and outbound vehicle movements through three Adelaide city gateways broken down by daily time periods. Data relates to weekdays in 2016. Data source is Adelaide City Council. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
